definition: A statement reporting mortgage interest received from individual borrowers, mortgage insurance premiums, points paid on principal residence purchases, and related mortgage loan information.

includes.text: Reports mortgage interest received from individual borrowers during the calendar year
Shows the outstanding principal balance on the mortgage as of a specific date
Identifies when the mortgage was originally created
Reports qualified mortgage insurance premiums paid during the tax year

excludes.text: Reports dividend and distribution payments from corporations and mutual funds
Reports interest income from savings accounts, bonds, and other non-mortgage sources
Reports miscellaneous income including rents, royalties, and other non-mortgage payments

discriminators.text: Reports mortgage-specific items including mortgage principal balance, origination date, and property address; the sibling reports dividend distributions from investments

Reports interest received in the course of a mortgage lending business with property securing the obligation; the sibling reports interest from savings and investment accounts without real property security
Focuses exclusively on mortgage interest, mortgage insurance premiums, and points on principal residence purchases; the sibling reports various miscellaneous income types from different sources
discriminators.quote: Points Paid on Purchase of Principal Residence
